parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, made primarily of glass with a thin metallic or plastic frame.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main visual interface for displaying images, videos, and data output from connected devices.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the supporting structure and does not move independently, though the entire display may tilt or rotate slightly.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of aluminum for stability and support.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and balance to the display, keeping it upright on a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Flat (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This is a flat component located below the screen, likely made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It may serve as a decorative or functional housing for speakers or control buttons.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move independently.
